points.ex_ja: もし宝くじで一億円当たったとしたら、何に使いますか。
points.ex_en: If you won 100 million yen in the lottery, what would you spend it on?
points.notes: Sets up a hypothesis and considers what follows. Often with もし or 仮に. としたら is more conversational; とすれば sounds more like logical reasoning.

points.meaning: even if; even supposing
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + としても
points.ex_ja: 親に反対されたとしても、私は留学するつもりだ。
points.ex_en: Even if my parents are against it, I intend to study abroad.
points.notes: Hypothetical concession: even assuming A, B still holds. More hypothetical than 〜ても; compare 〜にしても, which often accepts a fact.

points.meaning: I heard something like; apparently
points.formation: Sentence + とか
points.ex_ja: 駅前の本屋、今月で閉店するとか。寂しくなりますね。
points.ex_en: I hear the bookstore by the station is closing at the end of this month. It'll be sad to see it go.
points.notes: Vague hearsay; softer and less certain than 〜そうだ. Often 〜とかいう話だ, 〜とか聞いた, or 〜とかで (giving a reported reason). Different from listing 〜とか〜とか.

points.meaning: (casual quotation) says that; I heard; as for; what is
points.formation: Sentence + って / Noun + って
points.ex_ja: 彼女、今日は来られないって。
points.ex_en: She says she can't come today.
points.notes: Casual stand-in for と (quoting), そうだ (hearsay, often 〜んだって) and は (topic, especially 'what is X?'). Common in speech; avoided in formal writing.

points.meaning: I heard that; it means that; in other words
points.formation: Sentence + ということだ
points.ex_ja: 駅員さんの話では、事故のため電車は一時間ほど止まるということです。
points.ex_en: According to the station attendant, trains will be stopped for about an hour because of an accident.
points.notes: Two uses: reporting information (more formal than 〜そうだ) and drawing a conclusion ('so that means ...'). The conclusion use often ends in ということですね.

points.meaning: what is meant by ... is; ... means; the reason is
points.formation: Noun / Sentence + というのは
points.ex_ja: 「割り勘」というのは、食事代などをみんなで同じ金額ずつ払うことです。
points.ex_en: 'Warikan' means everyone paying the same share of a meal or other bill.
points.notes: Introduces a word to define or a situation to comment on. Casual: 〜って. At the start of a sentence, というのは introduces a reason ending in 〜からだ. Written: 〜とは.

points.meaning: rather than; not so much A as B
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というより
points.ex_ja: 今日は涼しいというより、寒いくらいだ。
points.ex_en: Today it's not so much cool as almost cold.
points.notes: Corrects or refines a description: the second one fits better. Often followed by むしろ.

points.meaning: considering; for (unexpectedly)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わりに
points.ex_ja: この店は値段のわりに、量が多くておいしい。
points.ex_en: For the price, this restaurant gives you big, tasty portions.
points.notes: The result doesn't match the degree you'd expect from A (price, age, effort). Can follow adjectives, unlike 〜にしては.

points.meaning: even though; despite (critical, reproachful)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + くせに
points.ex_ja: 自分では何もしないくせに、人の仕事には文句ばかり言う。
points.ex_en: He never does anything himself, yet he's always complaining about other people's work.
points.notes: Like 〜のに, but with contempt or reproach toward the subject. Both clauses share the same subject; rarely used about oneself. Casual.

points.meaning: from ... through; over (a period or area)
points.formation: Noun + から + Noun + にかけて
points.ex_ja: 今夜から明日の朝にかけて、強い雨が降るでしょう。
points.ex_en: Heavy rain is expected from tonight through tomorrow morning.
points.notes: A rough span of time or space whose edges aren't exact; common in weather reports. Compare 〜から〜まで, which marks clear start and end points.

points.meaning: for the first time in (a period); manner, way of doing
points.formation: Noun + ぶり / Verb-stem + ぶり
points.ex_ja: 五年ぶりに高校の友達に会って、話が止まらなかった。
points.ex_en: I saw my high school friends for the first time in five years, and we couldn't stop talking.
points.notes: Time span + ぶり: the first time in that long (〜ぶりに / 〜ぶりの). Noun or Verb-stem + ぶり: the way someone does something (仕事ぶり, 話しぶり).

points.meaning: was it?; did I?; (trying to recall)
points.formation: Verb-ta / Noun + だ / Noun + だった + っけ
points.ex_ja: あれ、会議って何時からだっけ？
points.ex_en: Wait, what time does the meeting start again?
points.notes: Checks something you've forgotten, or recalls the past fondly (〜たっけ). Polite forms: 〜でしたっけ, 〜ましたっけ.

points.meaning: I hope; may (wish, prayer)
points.formation: Verb-stem + ますように / Verb-stem + ませんように
points.ex_ja: 試験に合格できますように。
points.ex_en: I hope I pass the exam.
points.notes: Used for wishes and prayers, e.g. at a shrine or on tanabata strips, and at the end of letters wishing someone well.

points.meaning: pretend to; act as if
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + ふりをする
points.ex_ja: 母に呼ばれたが、聞こえないふりをしてゲームを続けた。
points.ex_en: My mother called me, but I pretended not to hear and kept playing my game.
points.notes: Deliberately giving a false impression. Verb-ta is common: 寝たふり, 死んだふり.

points.meaning: suitable for / aimed at; intended for
points.formation: Noun + 向き / Noun + 向け
points.ex_ja: この料理は作り方が簡単なので、初心者向きだ。
points.ex_en: This dish is easy to make, so it's well suited to beginners.
points.notes: 向き: happens to suit X well. 向け: made on purpose for X. 向き also means 'facing' (南向きの部屋).

points.meaning: tend to; be prone to; often
points.formation: Verb-stem / Noun + がち
points.ex_ja: 冬になると、つい家にこもりがちになる。
points.ex_en: When winter comes, I tend to stay cooped up at home.
points.notes: A frequent tendency toward something undesirable. Compare 〜やすい (easily happens, can be neutral) and 〜気味 (a slight sign of a condition now).

points.meaning: a touch of; slightly; somewhat (in that condition)
points.formation: Noun / Verb-stem + 気味
points.ex_ja: 少し風邪気味なので、今日は早めに帰ります。
points.ex_en: I have a bit of a cold, so I'll head home early today.
points.notes: A slight sign of a (usually negative) condition at present. Compare 〜がち, which means something happens often.

points.meaning: full of; covered with; riddled with
points.formation: Noun + だらけ
points.ex_ja: 子どもたちは、泥だらけになって帰ってきた。
points.ex_en: The children came home covered in mud.
points.notes: An unpleasantly large amount of something covering or filling a place; usually negative. Compare N1 〜まみれ (covered in something sticky or dirty).

points.meaning: do completely; finish / can't finish; too many to
points.formation: Verb-stem + 切る / Verb-stem + 切れない
points.ex_ja: 三時間かけて、長い小説を最後まで読み切った。
points.ex_en: It took three hours, but I read the long novel right to the end.
points.notes: Doing something through to the very end. Also describes a total state: 疲れ切る ('be utterly exhausted'). Often written in kana: 〜きる / 〜きれない.

points.meaning: half-done; start to; be about to
points.formation: Verb-stem + かける / Verb-stem + かけの + Noun
points.ex_ja: 読みかけの本が、机の上に置いてある。
points.ex_en: There's a half-read book on the desk.
points.notes: An action has started but isn't finished, or something is on the verge of happening (死にかける). Verb-stem + かけの + noun describes the half-finished thing.

points.meaning: do to each other; do together
points.formation: Verb-stem + 合う
points.ex_ja: 困ったときは、お互いに助け合いましょう。
points.ex_en: Let's help each other out when things get tough.
points.notes: Reciprocal or shared action. Many compounds are set words: 話し合う, 知り合う, 付き合う, 助け合う.

points.meaning: redo; do over again (to fix or improve)
points.formation: Verb-stem + 直す
points.ex_ja: 名前を間違えたので、書類を書き直した。
points.ex_en: I got the name wrong, so I rewrote the document.
points.notes: Doing something again in order to correct or improve it. Plain repetition (もう一度〜する) doesn't carry that sense of fixing.

points.meaning: hard to; difficult or uncomfortable to
points.formation: Verb-stem + づらい
points.ex_ja: この靴は少し小さくて、歩きづらい。
points.ex_en: These shoes are a bit small, so they're hard to walk in.
points.notes: Stresses the doer's physical or psychological discomfort. 〜にくい (N4) is more objective, describing a thing's nature. Formal N2: 〜がたい.

points.romaji: beki da / beki de wa nai
points.meaning: should; ought to / should not
points.formation: Verb-dict + べきだ / Verb-dict + べきではない
points.ex_ja: 自分が悪いと思ったら、すぐに謝るべきだ。
points.ex_en: If you think you were in the wrong, you should apologize right away.
points.notes: A strong opinion about what is right or one's duty; too blunt to use toward superiors. する → すべき or するべき. Compare 〜ほうがいい (advice) and 〜ものだ (social norm).

points.meaning: nothing is as ... as; there's no ... like
points.formation: Noun + ほど + i-Adj / na-Adj + な + Noun + はない
points.ex_ja: 仕事の後に飲む冷たいビールほどおいしいものはない。
points.ex_en: Nothing tastes as good as an ice-cold beer after work.
points.notes: Says X is the most ... of all, usually from personal experience or feeling. Also 〜くらい〜はない.

points.meaning: have no choice but to; can only
points.formation: Verb-dict + しかない
points.ex_ja: 終電に乗り遅れたから、タクシーで帰るしかない。
points.ex_en: I missed the last train, so I have no choice but to take a taxi home.
points.notes: No other option exists, so the speaker accepts this one. Differs from Noun + しか〜ない ('only'). Formal N2 equivalent: 〜ほかない.

points.meaning: even (an extreme case)
points.formation: Noun + まで / Noun + にまで
points.ex_ja: 最近は、小学生までスマホを持っている。
points.ex_en: These days even elementary school kids have smartphones.
points.notes: Adds an extreme item on top of others, often with surprise or dismay. Compare 〜さえ, which picks out one extreme example on its own.

points.meaning: almost; nearly (but didn't)
points.formation: Verb-dict + ところだった
points.ex_ja: 考え事をしていて、もう少しで車にひかれるところだった。
points.ex_en: I was lost in thought and nearly got hit by a car.
points.notes: Something (usually bad) came very close to happening but didn't. Often with もう少しで, 危うく or a 〜たら clause. Compare 〜そうになった.

points.meaning: just because (... doesn't mean); simply because
points.formation: Sentence + からといって
points.ex_ja: 日本人だからといって、みんなが敬語を正しく使えるわけではない。
points.ex_en: Just because someone is Japanese doesn't mean they can use keigo correctly.
points.notes: Denies that a reason automatically leads to a conclusion. Usually followed by a negative such as 〜わけではない or 〜とは限らない. Casual: 〜からって.

points.meaning: as; in the way that; exactly as
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + とおりに / Noun + どおりに
points.ex_ja: 説明書に書いてあるとおりに組み立てたのに、うまく動かない。
points.ex_en: I put it together exactly as the manual says, but it doesn't work properly.
points.notes: Doing something exactly like a model, instruction or prediction. Directly after a noun it becomes どおり (予定どおり, 思いどおり). に is often dropped. そのとおりだ = 'exactly'.

points.meaning: things like; the likes of (dismissive or humble); how ...! (surprise)
points.formation: Noun + なんか / Noun + なんて / Sentence + なんて
points.ex_ja: 私なんか、まだまだ初心者です。
points.ex_en: Someone like me is still just a beginner.
points.notes: Casual version of など with a dismissive, humble or surprised tone. なんか also softens suggestions (お茶なんかどう？). Sentence + なんて shows surprise or disbelief.

points.meaning: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
points.formation: Noun + に際して / Verb-dict + に際して / Noun + に際しての + Noun
points.ex_ja: 新製品の発売に際して、記者会見が開かれた。
points.ex_en: A press conference was held on the occasion of the new product's launch.
points.notes: Formal; for special, one-off occasions (ceremonies, departures, contracts). Near-synonym of 〜にあたって, which adds a sense of preparing for or facing the event; に際して simply marks the occasion.

points.meaning: along with; as; accompanying
points.formation: Noun + に伴って / Verb-dict + の + に伴って / Noun + に伴う + Noun
points.ex_ja: 高齢化に伴って、医療費は年々増加している。
points.ex_en: Along with the aging of the population, medical costs are rising year by year.
points.notes: 〜に伴い is the more written form. Like 〜につれて it can describe gradual change, but it also covers one-off events that bring about another (e.g. a relocation).

points.meaning: according to; depending on; in response to
points.formation: Noun + に応じて / Noun + に応じた + Noun
points.ex_ja: この奨学金は、家庭の収入に応じて支給額が変わる。
points.ex_en: The amount of this scholarship varies according to household income.
points.notes: B is adjusted to match A (ability, budget, season, requests). Compare 〜次第で, which stresses that the outcome is decided entirely by A.

points.meaning: contrary to; against; in violation of
points.formation: Noun + に反して / Noun + に反する + Noun / Noun + に反した + Noun
points.ex_ja: 大方の予想に反して、無名の新人が優勝した。
points.ex_en: Contrary to most people's predictions, an unknown newcomer won the championship.
points.notes: Used with nouns like 予想, 期待, 意思, 規則. With a rule or law as the noun, it means 'in violation of'.

points.meaning: based on; on the basis of
points.formation: Noun + に基づいて / Noun + に基づく + Noun / Noun + に基づいた + Noun
points.ex_ja: この映画は実際に起きた事件に基づいて制作された。
points.ex_en: This film was made based on an incident that actually happened.
points.notes: The basis is a firm standard such as data, law, facts or experience, and B follows it closely. Compare 〜をもとに, used for material from which something new is created.

points.meaning: over; throughout; spanning (a whole period or area)
points.formation: Noun + にわたって / Noun + にわたる + Noun
points.ex_ja: 工事は三か月にわたって行われる予定だ。
points.ex_en: The construction is scheduled to take place over three months.
points.notes: Stresses the full extent of a long period, a wide area or many items (多岐にわたる). Not used for short or small spans.

points.meaning: along; in line with; following
points.formation: Noun + に沿って / Noun + に沿った + Noun
points.ex_ja: 川に沿って桜並木が二キロほど続いている。
points.ex_en: A row of cherry trees stretches for about two kilometers along the river.
points.notes: Literal use: along a road, river or coast. Abstract use: following a plan, policy, or someone's wishes.

points.meaning: in addition to; on top of
points.formation: Noun + に加えて
points.ex_ja: 今年は猛暑に加えて雨不足が続き、野菜の価格が高騰している。
points.ex_en: This year, on top of the extreme heat, there has been a prolonged lack of rain, and vegetable prices have soared.
points.notes: Somewhat formal; 〜に加え is the written form. The added item is often marked with も.

points.meaning: over; concerning; surrounding (an issue of dispute)
points.formation: Noun + をめぐって / Noun + をめぐる + Noun
points.ex_ja: 新しい空港の建設をめぐって、住民の意見が二つに分かれている。
points.ex_en: Residents are divided over the construction of a new airport.
points.notes: The verb that follows is about debate, conflict or competition (議論する, 対立する, 争う). Unlike 〜について, it isn't used for simply explaining a topic.

points.meaning: through; via; by way of; throughout (a period)
points.formation: Noun + を通じて / Noun + を通して
points.ex_ja: 共通の友人を通じて、今の妻と知り合った。
points.ex_en: I got to know my wife through a mutual friend.
points.notes: Largely interchangeable. 〜を通して tends to stress a deliberate process or experience; 〜を通じて is a little more formal and common with media, contacts and periods (一年を通じて).

points.meaning: taking the opportunity of; triggered by; with ... as the start
points.formation: Noun + をきっかけに / Noun + をきっかけとして / Verb-plain + の + をきっかけに
points.ex_ja: 大学時代の留学をきっかけに、国際協力の仕事に興味を持つようになった。
points.ex_en: Studying abroad in college got me interested in international cooperation work.
points.notes: Marks an event that led to a new start or change. The formal equivalent 〜を契機に is common in writing.

points.meaning: except; excluding; apart from
points.formation: Noun + を除いて / Noun + を除き / Noun + を除く + Noun
points.ex_ja: 年末年始を除いて、図書館は毎日開いている。
points.ex_en: The library is open every day except during the New Year holidays.
points.notes: More formal than 〜以外. 〜を除き is the written form.

points.meaning: as if; as though (when it isn't really so)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj + かのようだ / na-Adj + である + かのようだ / Noun + である + かのようだ
points.ex_ja: 彼はまるで何も知らないかのような顔をしていた。
points.ex_en: He wore a look as if he knew nothing at all.
points.notes: More literary than 〜ようだ and clearly signals that the comparison is not literally true. Often paired with まるで. Also 〜かのように / 〜かのような.

points.meaning: could well; might (lead to something bad)
points.formation: Verb-stem + かねない
points.ex_ja: そんな無理な運転をしていたら、大事故を起こしかねない。
points.ex_en: If you keep driving that recklessly, you could end up causing a serious accident.
points.notes: Only for undesirable outcomes. Despite the ない, the meaning is positive: 'there's a real risk that ...'. Don't confuse with 〜かねる (cannot).

points.meaning: cannot; be unable to (polite refusal); find it hard to
points.formation: Verb-stem + かねる
points.ex_ja: 申し訳ございませんが、そのご質問にはお答えしかねます。
points.ex_en: I'm very sorry, but I'm unable to answer that question.
points.notes: A soft, formal way to decline, very common in customer service. It expresses reluctance or difficulty for the speaker, not physical inability.

points.meaning: can't help doing; can't resist doing
points.formation: Verb-nai stem + ずにはいられない
points.ex_ja: あまりにひどいニュースに、怒りを感じずにはいられなかった。
points.ex_en: I couldn't help feeling angry at such terrible news.
points.notes: する becomes せずにはいられない. 〜ないではいられない is a slightly more conversational equivalent. An inner urge, unlike 〜ざるを得ない (forced by circumstances).

points.meaning: have no choice but to; cannot help but
points.formation: Verb-nai stem + ざるを得ない
points.ex_ja: 予算が足りないので、計画を縮小せざるを得ない。
points.ex_en: The budget is insufficient, so we have no choice but to scale back the plan.
points.notes: Circumstances force an action the speaker doesn't really want to take. する becomes せざるを得ない. More formal than 〜しかない.

points.meaning: can't afford to (keep) doing; can't just
points.formation: Verb-te + はいられない
points.ex_ja: 締め切りが迫っているので、のんびりしてはいられない。
points.ex_en: The deadline is approaching, so I can't afford to take it easy.
points.notes: The situation doesn't allow one to stay in state A, so one feels pushed to act. Casual: 〜ちゃいられない / 〜てらんない.

points.meaning: no way (will I); as if; I'll never
points.formation: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものか
points.ex_ja: あんな失礼な店には、二度と行くものか。
points.ex_en: No way am I ever going to that rude shop again.
points.notes: Strong emotional denial or refusal; not a real question. Conversational form: 〜もんか; polite/feminine: 〜ものですか.

points.meaning: although; even though (but the expected result doesn't follow)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ものの
points.ex_ja: 免許は取ったものの、怖くてまだ一度も運転していない。
points.ex_en: Although I got my license, I'm too scared and still haven't driven once.
points.notes: Admits the first fact, then says things didn't go as it would suggest. More written than 〜けれども.

points.meaning: if (it were possible); if only one could
points.formation: Verb-dict (potential form) + ものなら
points.ex_ja: できるものなら、学生時代に戻ってもう一度やり直したい。
points.ex_en: If only I could, I'd go back to my student days and do it all over again.
points.notes: For something hard or impossible to do; the main clause is often 〜たい or a challenge. Don't confuse with N1 〜(よ)うものなら ('if one dared to ..., something bad would happen').

points.meaning: rather than; if it comes to (doing that), I'd rather
points.formation: Verb-dict + くらいなら / Verb-dict + ぐらいなら
points.ex_ja: あんな人に頭を下げるくらいなら、会社を辞めたほうがましだ。
points.ex_en: I'd rather quit my job than bow my head to someone like him.
points.notes: A is something the speaker strongly dislikes; B is the lesser evil or better choice, often with 〜ほうがいい / 〜ほうがましだ.

points.meaning: there is something (about it that is) ...; it really is
points.formation: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものがある
points.ex_ja: この画家の初期の作品には、見る人の心を強く打つものがある。
points.ex_en: There is something in this painter's early works that deeply moves the viewer.
points.notes: Expresses the speaker's strong impression of a quality sensed in something. It's an evaluation, not a statement about literal existence.

points.meaning: how ...!; how much ...!
points.formation: Question word + … + Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことか
points.ex_ja: この日が来るのを、どれほど待ち望んだことか。
points.ex_en: How long I've waited for this day to come!
points.notes: Usually paired with どんなに, どれほど, 何度, etc. Not a real question; it conveys deep feeling. Slightly written or dramatic in tone.

points.meaning: (emotion)-ly; what is (surprising, sad, etc.) is that
points.formation: Verb-ta / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことに（は）
points.ex_ja: 驚いたことに、彼は会社を辞めてパン屋を開いたそうだ。
points.ex_en: Surprisingly, I heard he quit his company and opened a bakery.
points.notes: An emotion word (驚いた, 残念な, うれしい, 不思議な) states the speaker's feeling before giving the fact. Fairly written.

points.meaning: knowing (someone); since it's (someone), surely
points.formation: Noun + の + ことだから
points.ex_ja: 几帳面な彼のことだから、書類はもう準備してあるだろう。
points.ex_en: Knowing how meticulous he is, he's probably got the documents ready already.
points.notes: From what the speaker knows of a person's character, it leads to a guess about their behavior. Usually followed by だろう, きっと or に違いない.

points.meaning: without (doing); without ever
points.formation: Verb-dict + ことなく
points.ex_ja: 彼は三十年間、一日も休むことなく店を開け続けた。
points.ex_en: For thirty years, he kept his shop open without taking a single day off.
points.notes: A written equivalent of 〜ないで / 〜ずに, often implying that something one might expect to happen did not.

points.meaning: from the fact that; because; judging from
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ことから
points.ex_ja: この坂は、昔から桜の名所であることから「桜坂」と呼ばれている。
points.ex_en: This slope is called 'Sakura-zaka' because it has long been a famous spot for cherry blossoms.
points.notes: Gives the evidence or origin behind a name, judgment or conclusion. Common in explanations of place names and in reports.

points.meaning: unless; if ... not (then it can't happen)
points.formation: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない / Noun + でない + ことには
points.ex_ja: 実際に会って話してみないことには、どんな人か分からない。
points.ex_en: You can't tell what someone is like unless you actually meet and talk to them.
points.notes: The main clause is negative (分からない, できない, 始まらない): without A, B can't happen. More emphatic than 〜なければ.

points.meaning: it's true that ..., but; (I) do ..., but
points.formation: Verb-plain + ことは + Verb-plain + が / i-Adj + ことは + i-Adj + が / na-Adj + な + ことは + na-Adj + だ + が
points.ex_ja: あの映画、見たことは見たけど、途中で寝てしまった。
points.ex_en: I did watch that movie, but I fell asleep halfway through.
points.notes: The same word is repeated to admit something only partly before adding a reservation. けど replaces が in speech.

points.meaning: after (a long, troublesome process); in the end
points.formation: Verb-ta + あげく / Noun + の + あげく
points.ex_ja: さんざん迷ったあげく、結局どちらも買わなかった。
points.ex_en: After agonizing over it for ages, in the end I didn't buy either.
points.notes: The result is usually negative or disappointing. 〜末(に) is neutral and can end well; あげく stresses frustration. あげくの果てに is an intensified form.

points.meaning: so much that; out of excessive; because of too much
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + あまり（に）
points.ex_ja: 彼女は緊張のあまり、スピーチの内容を忘れてしまった。
points.ex_en: She was so nervous that she forgot what she was going to say in her speech.
points.notes: An extreme degree of a feeling or state leads to an unusual, often unwanted result. Mostly with emotion nouns (緊張, 心配, 驚き, 悲しみ).

points.meaning: besides; on top of; in addition to
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + である + 上（に）
points.ex_ja: あのレストランは料理がおいしい上に、値段も手頃だ。
points.ex_en: That restaurant has delicious food, and on top of that, the prices are reasonable.
points.notes: Adds a second point of the same kind (good + good, bad + bad). に may be dropped in writing. It isn't normally followed by a command or request.

points.meaning: after (doing), upon; in (doing), when it comes to
points.formation: Verb-ta + 上で / Noun + の + 上で / Verb-dict + 上で
points.ex_ja: 家族とよく相談した上で、お返事いたします。
points.ex_en: I'll give you my answer after discussing it carefully with my family.
points.notes: Verb-ta + 上で: do A first, then B on that basis. Verb-dict + 上で: 'in the process of / for the purpose of A'. Business writing often shortens it to ご確認の上.

points.meaning: since; now that; as long as
points.formation: Verb-plain / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 以上（は）
points.ex_ja: 引き受けた以上は、最後まで責任を持ってやり遂げるつもりだ。
points.ex_en: Now that I've taken it on, I intend to see it through responsibly to the end.
points.notes: From a given situation, draws an obligation, resolve or firm judgment. Near-synonym of 〜からには; 以上は sounds more formal and logical, からには more like personal resolve.

points.meaning: now that; since (having done/being ..., one must)
points.formation: Verb-plain / Noun + である + からには
points.ex_ja: オリンピックに出るからには、メダルを狙いたい。
points.ex_en: Since I'm competing in the Olympics, I want to go for a medal.
points.notes: Expresses resolve: having reached this situation, one should see it through. Often ends with 〜たい, 〜つもりだ, 〜なければならない. Compare 〜以上(は), which is more formal and neutral.

points.meaning: precisely because; it is because ... that
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + からこそ
points.ex_ja: 君のことを思っているからこそ、厳しいことを言うんだ。
points.ex_en: It's precisely because I care about you that I'm being hard on you.
points.notes: Stresses that this reason, and no other, is the real one, often a reason the listener wouldn't expect. Frequently ends with 〜のだ.

points.meaning: judging from; (starting) even with; to begin with
points.formation: Noun + からして
points.ex_ja: 空の様子からして、午後は雨になりそうだ。
points.ex_en: Judging from the look of the sky, it's likely to rain in the afternoon.
points.notes: Two uses: 'judging from X' (basis for a guess), and 'even X, let alone the rest', where one example stands for the whole, often critically.

points.meaning: judging from; from the standpoint of
points.formation: Noun + からすると / Noun + からすれば
points.ex_ja: あの話し方からすると、彼は関西の出身だろう。
points.ex_en: Judging from the way he talks, he's probably from the Kansai area.
points.notes: Gives either the evidence for a judgment or the viewpoint of a person. Close to 〜から見ると; unlike 〜からいうと, it can take a person.

points.meaning: from the point of view of; judging from; seen from
points.formation: Noun + から見ると / Noun + から見れば
points.ex_ja: 外国人から見ると、日本の習慣には不思議なものが多いらしい。
points.ex_en: Apparently, from a foreigner's point of view, many Japanese customs seem strange.
points.notes: Looks at something from a person's position or from given evidence. 〜から見て and 〜から見ても are also common.

points.meaning: in terms of; from the standpoint of; judging by
points.formation: Noun + からいうと / Noun + からいって
points.ex_ja: 立地からいうと、駅前のマンションのほうが便利だ。
points.ex_en: In terms of location, the apartment in front of the station is more convenient.
points.notes: The noun is a criterion or viewpoint (立場, 経験, 値段), not a person: say 親からすると, not ×親からいうと. 〜からいえば is also used.

points.meaning: when; at the time of; on the occasion of
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + 際（に）
points.ex_ja: お降りの際は、お忘れ物のないようご注意ください。
points.ex_en: When getting off, please make sure you don't leave anything behind.
points.notes: A formal version of 〜とき, common in announcements and instructions. Unlike 〜に際して, it's fine for everyday occasions.

points.meaning: as soon as (then immediately)
points.formation: Verb-stem + 次第 / Noun + 次第
points.ex_ja: 詳しい日程が決まり次第、皆様にご連絡いたします。
points.ex_en: We will contact everyone as soon as the detailed schedule is decided.
points.notes: Formal, for a planned future action that follows right after A (contacting, starting). Not used when the main clause is in the past. Compare 〜次第で (depending on).

points.meaning: depending on; it depends on
points.formation: Noun + 次第だ / Noun + 次第で / Noun + 次第では
points.ex_ja: 合格できるかどうかは、これからの努力次第だ。
points.ex_en: Whether you pass depends on your efforts from now on.
points.notes: The outcome is decided by A. 〜次第では points to one possible outcome among several.

points.meaning: after (a long process of); finally, at the end of
points.formation: Verb-ta + 末（に） / Noun + の + 末（に）
points.ex_ja: 半年にわたる交渉の末、両社はようやく合意に達した。
points.ex_en: After six months of negotiations, the two companies finally reached an agreement.
points.notes: Neutral: the outcome may be good or bad and is often a decision or conclusion. Use 〜あげく when the result is negative or frustrating.

points.meaning: even if (it would be no use); no matter how much
points.formation: Verb-ta + ところで
points.ex_ja: 今から急いだところで、終電には間に合わないだろう。
points.ex_en: Even if we hurry now, we probably won't make the last train.
points.notes: The main clause says the effort is useless or the result wouldn't matter much. Often with いくら, どんなに, 今さら. Different from 〜たところ (when I did, I found).

points.meaning: when (I) did ..., (I found that); upon doing
points.formation: Verb-ta + ところ
points.ex_ja: 駅の窓口で問い合わせたところ、その電車は運休しているとのことだった。
points.ex_en: When I asked at the station window, I was told that the train wasn't running.
points.notes: Reports what turned out after an action, often a discovery. The result is a past fact beyond the speaker's control. More formal than 〜たら.

points.meaning: not only ... but also
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ばかりか
points.ex_ja: 彼は約束の時間に遅れたばかりか、謝りもしなかった。
points.ex_en: Not only was he late, he didn't even apologize.
points.notes: Stronger than 〜だけでなく; the second item is often more surprising and marked by も, まで or さえ. Unlike 〜だけでなく, it isn't followed by commands or requests.

points.meaning: simply because; just because (with a bad result)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ばかりに
points.ex_ja: 確認を一つ怠ったばかりに、大きな損害を出してしまった。
points.ex_en: Simply because I skipped one check, I ended up causing heavy losses.
points.notes: The main clause is an unwanted result, often with regret. The set form 〜たいばかりに ('just because one wanted to') explains a strong motive.

points.meaning: keep (getting worse); only continue to
points.formation: Verb-dict + ばかりだ
points.ex_ja: 駅前の商店街は、客が減るばかりだ。
points.ex_en: The shopping street in front of the station just keeps losing customers.
points.notes: Change continuing in one direction, almost always for the worse. 〜一方だ (N3) is similar but can also describe neutral or good trends.

points.meaning: not to mention; of course ... and also
points.formation: Noun + はもちろん / Noun + はもとより
points.ex_ja: この公園は、週末はもちろん平日も家族連れでにぎわう。
points.ex_en: This park is busy with families on weekdays, not to mention weekends.
points.notes: A is the obvious case; B is added with も or まで. 〜はもとより is more formal and written than 〜はもちろん.

points.meaning: setting aside; regardless of; whatever about
points.formation: Noun + はともかく / Noun + はともかくとして
points.ex_ja: 見た目はともかく、味はなかなかいい。
points.ex_en: Looks aside, it tastes pretty good.
points.notes: Sets A aside to focus on B, which the speaker sees as more important. Compare 〜はさておき, used more to shelve a topic for now and move on.

points.meaning: leaving aside; putting aside (for now)
points.formation: Noun + はさておき
points.ex_ja: 冗談はさておき、そろそろ本題に入りましょう。
points.ex_en: Joking aside, let's get down to business.
points.notes: Often used to switch to the main point, as in 冗談はさておき or それはさておき. Slightly more formal than 〜はともかく.

points.meaning: on the other hand; while (it is ...)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 反面
points.ex_ja: 都会の暮らしは便利な反面、ストレスも多い。
points.ex_en: City life is convenient, but on the other hand it's also stressful.
points.notes: Presents two opposite sides of the same thing. 〜一方で (N3) is broader and can also contrast two different things.

points.meaning: although; despite; while (contrary to expectation)
points.formation: Verb-stem / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + ながら（も）
points.ex_ja: 狭いながらも、日当たりのいい快適な部屋だ。
points.ex_en: Although it's small, it's a comfortable, sunny room.
points.notes: Not the 'while doing' ながら: the subject is in state A, yet B is true. Set phrases: 残念ながら, 知りながら, 及ばずながら.

points.meaning: while (doing); although, even while
points.formation: Verb-stem + つつ / Verb-stem + つつも
points.ex_ja: 今年の業績を振り返りつつ、来年の目標を考えたい。
points.ex_en: While looking back on this year's results, I'd like to think about next year's goals.
points.notes: つつ alone is a written 〜ながら (two actions at once). つつも means 'although', typically with verbs of knowing or thinking (思いつつ, 知りつつ).

points.meaning: be in the process of; be gradually (changing)
points.formation: Verb-stem + つつある
points.ex_ja: 地球の平均気温は、年々上昇しつつある。
points.ex_en: The earth's average temperature is steadily rising year by year.
points.notes: Written style for change that is underway toward some result. Used with change verbs (増える, 回復する, 変わる), not with simple ongoing actions like 食べる.

points.meaning: leaving (something) as is; keep (doing) without a break
points.formation: Verb-stem + っぱなし
points.ex_ja: 部屋の電気をつけっぱなしにして出かけてしまった。
points.ex_en: I went out and left the light on in my room.
points.notes: Either something left undone that should have been dealt with (often a complaint), or a state that goes on without a break. Conversational.

points.meaning: do to the very end; see through; do thoroughly
points.formation: Verb-stem + 抜く
points.ex_ja: 足を痛めていたが、彼は最後まで走り抜いた。
points.ex_en: Although he had hurt his leg, he ran all the way to the finish.
points.notes: Stresses finishing something hard despite difficulty, or doing it to the fullest (考え抜く, 生き抜く).

points.meaning: can; be possible / cannot; be impossible
points.formation: Verb-stem + 得る / Verb-stem + 得ない
points.ex_ja: どんなに注意していても、事故は起こり得る。
points.ex_en: No matter how careful you are, accidents can happen.
points.notes: Logical possibility, not personal skill (not ×泳ぎ得る for 'can swim'). The positive is read うる or える; other forms use え- (えない, えた).

points.meaning: hard to; almost impossible to (emotionally)
points.formation: Verb-stem + がたい
points.ex_ja: あの誠実な人が不正をしたとは、信じがたい。
points.ex_en: It's hard to believe that such an honest person committed fraud.
points.notes: Used with verbs of thinking and feeling (信じる, 理解する, 許す, 離れる). Unlike 〜にくい, not for physical difficulty (×この肉は食べがたい).

points.meaning: there's no way to; cannot possibly (no means available)
points.formation: Verb-stem + ようがない / Noun + の + しようがない
points.ex_ja: 連絡先が分からないので、知らせようがない。
points.ex_en: I don't have his contact details, so there's no way to let him know.
points.notes: There's no method at all, even if one wanted to. 〜ようもない is more emphatic. With suru-nouns: 説明のしようがない.

points.meaning: if (you are like this / keep doing this), (it's no good)
points.formation: Verb-plain + ようでは
points.ex_ja: こんな簡単なミスをするようでは、大きな仕事は任せられない。
points.ex_en: If you make simple mistakes like this, we can't trust you with big jobs.
points.notes: Criticizes an undesirable state and predicts a bad outcome; the main clause is negative (〜ない, 困る, だめだ).

points.meaning: can't help (feeling); feel terribly; extremely
points.formation: Verb-te + ならない / i-Adj-ku + てならない / na-Adj + でならない
points.ex_ja: 故郷の母のことが心配でならない。
points.ex_en: I can't stop worrying about my mother back home.
points.notes: For feelings or impressions that arise on their own (気がする, 思われる, 心配だ, 残念だ). More formal and written than 〜てたまらない / 〜てしょうがない.

points.meaning: only by (doing); only when
points.formation: Verb-te + こそ
points.ex_ja: 自分で経験してこそ、本当の意味で理解できるのだ。
points.ex_en: Only by experiencing it yourself can you truly understand it.
points.notes: Stresses that A is the essential condition for the real value or result in B. 〜てはじめて (N3) is more neutral, focusing on timing.

points.meaning: not until (after doing); only after
points.formation: Verb-te + からでないと / Verb-te + からでなければ
points.ex_ja: 実物を見てからでないと、買うかどうか決められない。
points.ex_en: I can't decide whether to buy it until I've seen the real thing.
points.notes: The main clause is negative or expresses difficulty: B can't happen unless A is done first.

points.meaning: ever since
points.formation: Verb-te + 以来 / Noun + 以来
points.ex_ja: 大学を卒業して以来、彼とは一度も会っていない。
points.ex_en: I haven't seen him once since we graduated from university.
points.notes: The main clause is a state or habit continuing from that past point up to now, not a single later event. More formal than 〜てから.

points.meaning: merely; nothing more than; only
points.formation: Verb-plain / Noun + に過ぎない
points.ex_ja: それは単なるうわさに過ぎない。
points.ex_en: That's nothing more than a rumor.
points.notes: Downplays something as small or unimportant. Often with ただ or 単なる.

points.meaning: nothing beats; the best thing is
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / Noun + に限る
points.ex_ja: 疲れたときは、早く寝るに限る。
points.ex_en: When you're tired, there's nothing better than going to bed early.
points.notes: The speaker's personal conviction that something is the best choice; conversational. For a more general 'it's best to', use 〜に越したことはない.

points.meaning: not only; not limited to
points.formation: Noun + に限らず
points.ex_ja: この遊園地は、子どもに限らず大人にも人気がある。
points.ex_en: This amusement park is popular not only with children but with adults as well.
points.notes: Widens the scope beyond A; the second part usually has も. Close to 〜だけでなく but a bit more formal.

points.meaning: of all (times/people); precisely when; (someone) of all people wouldn't
points.formation: Noun + に限って
points.ex_ja: 傘を持っていない日に限って、雨が降るんだよね。
points.ex_en: It always rains on exactly the days I don't have an umbrella.
points.notes: Two uses: (1) 'just when', complaining that bad luck strikes at the worst time; (2) with はずがない / ない, firm trust that a particular person wouldn't do something.

points.meaning: limited to; only (for)
points.formation: Noun + に限り
points.ex_ja: 本日ご来店のお客様に限り、全商品を二割引きいたします。
points.ex_en: For customers visiting today only, all items are 20% off.
points.notes: Formal; typical of notices, ads and rules to state who or what a condition applies to.

points.meaning: as long as; as far as (to the limit of)
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / i-Adj / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + かぎり
points.ex_ja: 私の知るかぎり、彼が約束を破ったことは一度もない。
points.ex_en: As far as I know, he has never once broken a promise.
points.notes: 'As long as' a condition holds, or 'as far as' the limit of knowledge or ability (私の知るかぎり, できるかぎり). Also written 限り. Different from 〜に限り (limited to).

points.meaning: unless; as long as ... not
points.formation: Verb-nai + かぎり
points.ex_ja: よほどのことがないかぎり、明日の会議には出席します。
points.ex_en: Unless something serious comes up, I'll attend tomorrow's meeting.
points.notes: B holds as long as A doesn't happen. More emphatic and formal than 〜なければ.

points.meaning: when it comes to; in terms of (skill)
points.formation: Noun + にかけては / Noun + にかけても
points.ex_ja: 料理の腕にかけては、うちの父は誰にも負けない。
points.ex_en: When it comes to cooking, my father is second to none.
points.notes: Praises someone's ability in a specific field; typically followed by 誰にも負けない, 一番だ, 自信がある.

points.meaning: in response to; meeting (expectations, requests)
points.formation: Noun + にこたえて / Noun + にこたえる + Noun
points.ex_ja: ファンの声援にこたえて、選手たちは手を振った。
points.ex_en: The players waved in response to the fans' cheers.
points.notes: Used with nouns like 期待, 要望, 声援, 要求. Also written 〜に応えて. Compare 〜に応じて, which means adjusting to a condition.

points.meaning: prior to; before
points.formation: Noun + に先立って / Verb-dict + に先立って / Noun + に先立つ + Noun
points.ex_ja: 新作映画の公開に先立って、完成披露試写会が開かれた。
points.ex_en: Prior to the release of the new film, a premiere screening was held.
points.notes: Formal; for preparations or events that come before an important occasion. 〜に先立ち is the written form.

points.meaning: even if; whether ... or ...; in any case
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + にしろ・にせよ
points.ex_ja: たとえ冗談にしろ、そんなことを言うべきではない。
points.ex_en: Even if it was a joke, you shouldn't say something like that.
points.notes: Same meaning as 〜にしても (N3) but more formal; にせよ is the most written. The paired form AにしろBにしろ means 'whether A or B'.

points.meaning: from the standpoint of; for (someone), (it would seem)
points.formation: Noun + にすれば / Noun + にしたら
points.ex_ja: 子どもにすれば、親の小言はうるさいだけなのだろう。
points.ex_en: From a child's point of view, parents' nagging is probably just annoying.
points.notes: Imagines how things feel from another person's position (usually not the speaker's). Unlike 〜にとって, it focuses on that person's feelings or opinion.

points.meaning: without doubt; must be; surely
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に相違ない
points.ex_ja: この筆跡は、父のものに相違ない。
points.ex_en: This handwriting is without doubt my father's.
points.notes: A written, formal equivalent of 〜に違いない (N3). Also seen on forms: 上記の通り相違ありません ('the above is correct').

points.meaning: it's best to; nothing is better than
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に越したことはない
points.ex_ja: どんなに健康でも、定期的に検診を受けるに越したことはない。
points.ex_en: No matter how healthy you are, it's best to get regular checkups.
points.notes: States a common-sense preference, often followed by が / けれど and a practical reservation. Compare 〜に限る, which is a more personal choice.

points.meaning: nothing other than; none other than; precisely
points.formation: Noun + にほかならない / Verb-plain + から + にほかならない
points.ex_ja: 今回の成功は、社員一人ひとりの努力の結果にほかならない。
points.ex_en: This success is nothing other than the result of each employee's efforts.
points.notes: Strongly asserts that this and nothing else is the case. 〜からにほかならない stresses a reason. Formal/written.

points.meaning: despite; in spite of; although
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + である / Noun + にもかかわらず
points.ex_ja: 悪天候にもかかわらず、大勢の観客が会場に集まった。
points.ex_en: Despite the bad weather, a large crowd gathered at the venue.
points.notes: A formal counterpart of 〜のに, common in news and writing; stresses that the result goes against what A would lead one to expect. Don't confuse with 〜にかかわらず (regardless of).

points.meaning: when; at the time of; on the occasion of (starting something important)
points.formation: Noun + にあたって / Verb-dict + にあたって / Noun + にあたっての + Noun
points.ex_ja: 新生活を始めるにあたって、必要な物をリストにまとめた。
points.ex_en: When starting my new life, I made a list of the things I'd need.
points.notes: Formal; used when facing an important undertaking, often with a sense of preparation or resolve. 〜に際して is similar but simply marks the occasion. Written form: 〜にあたり.

points.meaning: in; at; in the field of (formal)
points.formation: Noun + において / Noun + における + Noun
points.ex_ja: 卒業式は大講堂において行われます。
points.ex_en: The graduation ceremony will be held in the main auditorium.
points.notes: A formal version of で for places, times, fields or situations. Before a noun, the form is 〜における.

points.meaning: regardless of; irrespective of
points.formation: Noun + にかかわらず / Verb-dict + Verb-nai + にかかわらず
points.ex_ja: このセミナーは、経験の有無にかかわらず、どなたでも参加できます。
points.ex_en: Anyone can join this seminar, regardless of experience.
points.notes: Used with nouns implying a range or an opposite pair (年齢, 天候, 有無, 男女). Very close to 〜を問わず. Don't confuse with 〜にもかかわらず (despite).

points.meaning: affecting; concerning (something important); relating to
points.formation: Noun + にかかわる
points.ex_ja: これは人の命にかかわる問題だから、慎重に判断しなければならない。
points.ex_en: This is a matter of life and death, so we must judge carefully.
points.notes: Used for things with serious consequences: 命, 名誉, 信用, 将来. Also written 〜に関わる.

points.meaning: per; for each; due to (in formal notices)
points.formation: Noun + につき
points.ex_ja: 駐車料金は、一時間につき三百円です。
points.ex_en: Parking costs 300 yen per hour.
points.notes: Two separate uses: 'per' with quantities, and 'because of' on notices and signs (工事中につき). The reason use is very formal.

points.meaning: toward; aimed at; in preparation for; addressed to
points.formation: Noun + に向けて / Noun + に向けた + Noun
points.ex_ja: 来年の全国大会に向けて、毎日練習に励んでいる。
points.ex_en: We're practicing hard every day for next year's national tournament.
points.notes: Marks a goal or event being worked toward, or the audience something is directed at. Different from 〜向け (N3), 'designed for'.

points.romaji: no moto de / no moto ni
points.meaning: under (guidance, influence, a rule); with
points.formation: Noun + のもとで / Noun + のもとに
points.ex_ja: 私は大学院で、有名な教授のもとで研究を続けた。
points.ex_en: In graduate school, I continued my research under a famous professor.
points.notes: Under someone's guidance, protection or influence, or under a rule or condition. Often written 〜の下で / 〜の下に.

points.meaning: without; leaving out
points.formation: Noun + 抜きで / Noun + 抜きに / Noun + 抜きの + Noun
points.ex_ja: 今日は仕事の話抜きで、ゆっくり楽しみましょう。
points.ex_en: Let's leave work talk out of it today and just relax and enjoy ourselves.
points.notes: Leaves out something normally included. 〜抜きには〜ない / 〜を抜きにしては〜ない means 'can't ... without'.

points.meaning: with (feeling); full of; putting ... into
points.formation: Noun + をこめて
points.ex_ja: 母の誕生日に、感謝の気持ちをこめて手紙を書いた。
points.ex_en: For my mother's birthday, I wrote her a letter full of gratitude.
points.notes: Used with feelings or intentions (愛, 感謝, 願い, 心). Also written 〜を込めて.

points.meaning: centered on; focusing on; mainly
points.formation: Noun + を中心に / Noun + を中心として / Noun + を中心とした + Noun
points.ex_ja: 今回の地震では、沿岸部を中心に大きな被害が出た。
points.ex_en: In this earthquake, serious damage occurred mainly in coastal areas.
points.notes: A is the core or main part of a wider area, group or activity.

points.meaning: based on; using ... as a basis or source
points.formation: Noun + をもとに / Noun + をもとにして / Noun + をもとにした + Noun
points.ex_ja: この小説は、作者自身の体験をもとに書かれている。
points.ex_en: This novel is based on the author's own experiences.
points.notes: A is the material or hint from which something new is made. 〜に基づいて is used when strictly following a rule or fact as a standard.

points.meaning: regardless of; irrespective of
points.formation: Noun + を問わず
points.ex_ja: この仕事は、年齢や経験を問わず応募できます。
points.ex_en: Anyone can apply for this job regardless of age or experience.
points.notes: Used with nouns implying a range or an opposite pair (男女, 昼夜, 国内外). Very close to 〜にかかわらず; を問わず is typical of job ads and notices.

points.meaning: starting with; including; such as (a representative example)
points.formation: Noun + をはじめ / Noun + をはじめとして / Noun + をはじめとする + Noun
points.ex_ja: 京都には、金閣寺をはじめ、多くの有名な寺がある。
points.ex_en: Kyoto has many famous temples, including Kinkakuji.
points.notes: Names the most representative member of a group, then refers to the group as a whole. The main clause covers many items, not just A.

points.meaning: treating (A) as (B); with A as B
points.formation: Noun + を + Noun + として / Noun + を + Noun + とする
points.ex_ja: この大会は、地域の活性化を目的として開かれている。
points.ex_en: This event is held with the aim of revitalizing the local area.
points.notes: Puts A in the role or function of B; common B nouns are 目的, 目標, 中心, 対象, 条件. 〜を〜にして is a more casual variant.

points.meaning: if you ask whether (actually, not); the reason why ... is
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かというと / Question word + … + かというと
points.ex_ja: 高い料理ならおいしいかというと、必ずしもそうではない。
points.ex_en: Is expensive food always delicious? Not necessarily.
points.notes: With a question word (なぜ, どうして) it introduces an explanation. Without one, it raises a question only to deny the easy assumption (〜かというと、そうではない). Also 〜かといえば.

points.romaji: ka to omottara / ka to omou to
points.meaning: just when; no sooner than; the moment
points.formation: Verb-ta + かと思ったら / Verb-ta + かと思うと
points.ex_ja: 空が急に暗くなったかと思ったら、激しい雨が降り出した。
points.ex_en: No sooner had the sky suddenly gone dark than it started to pour.
points.notes: B follows A immediately and unexpectedly. It describes what the speaker observes, so it isn't used for the speaker's own actions.

points.romaji: ka ... nai ka no uchi ni
points.meaning: as soon as; barely ... when
points.formation: Verb-dict + か + Verb-nai + かのうちに / Verb-ta + か + Verb-nai + かのうちに
points.ex_ja: ベルが鳴るか鳴らないかのうちに、生徒たちは教室を飛び出した。
points.ex_en: The bell had barely rung when the students rushed out of the classroom.
points.notes: The same verb is repeated in positive and negative: it's unclear whether A has even finished before B happens. Describes observed events.

points.meaning: since (and nothing after); only; just
points.formation: Verb-ta + きり / Noun + きり
points.ex_ja: 兄は十年前に家を出たきり、一度も連絡をよこさない。
points.ex_en: My brother left home ten years ago and hasn't been in touch once since.
points.notes: Verb-ta + きり: something happened and the expected follow-up never came (often with ない). Noun + きり: 'only' (一度きり, 二人きり). Casual: 〜っきり.

points.meaning: seeming; looking (as if); with an air of
points.formation: i-Adj stem + げ / na-Adj + げ / Verb-stem + たげ
points.ex_ja: 彼女は窓の外を寂しげに見つめていた。
points.ex_en: She was gazing out the window with a lonely look.
points.notes: Describes a feeling visible in someone's face or manner; conjugates like a na-adjective (〜げな, 〜げに). Rather literary.

points.meaning: no way; there's absolutely no chance
points.formation: Verb-stem + っこない
points.ex_ja: こんな量の仕事、一日で終わりっこないよ。
points.ex_en: There's no way this much work will get done in one day.
points.notes: Casual speech only; often with potential verbs (できっこない, 分かりっこない). A casual equivalent of 〜わけがない.

points.meaning: far from; let alone; on the contrary
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + どころか
points.ex_ja: 薬を飲んだが、熱は下がるどころか、ますます高くなった。
points.ex_en: I took medicine, but far from going down, my fever got even higher.
points.notes: Either the reality is the opposite of A, or not even something lesser than A is possible (AどころかBも〜ない).

points.meaning: this is no time for; out of the question
points.formation: Verb-dict / Noun + どころではない
points.ex_ja: 来週は試験なので、遊びに行くどころではない。
points.ex_en: I have exams next week, so this is no time to be going out.
points.notes: The circumstances make A impossible or unthinkable right now. Casual: 〜どころじゃない.

points.meaning: not necessarily; not always
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とは限らない
points.ex_ja: 値段が高いからといって、品質がいいとは限らない。
points.ex_en: Just because something is expensive doesn't necessarily mean it's good quality.
points.notes: Denies that something is always true; often with 必ずしも or 〜からといって.

points.meaning: that's what (A) is; that's just how it is; that's really
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というものだ
points.ex_ja: 困っている人がいたら助ける。それが人情というものだ。
points.ex_en: When someone's in trouble, you help them. That's what human kindness is.
points.notes: A firm opinion about what something really is or how things naturally are. Often used to criticize an attitude.

points.romaji: to iu mono de wa nai
points.meaning: it's not (necessarily) the case that; it doesn't follow that
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というものではない
points.ex_ja: 練習は長くやればいいというものではない。
points.ex_en: Longer practice isn't automatically better practice.
points.notes: Rejects an oversimplified belief; often with 〜ばいい or 〜さえ〜ば. 〜というものでもない is a softer variant.

points.meaning: although I say; even though (it's called)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + といっても
points.ex_ja: 料理ができるといっても、簡単なものしか作れません。
points.ex_en: I say I can cook, but I can only make simple things.
points.notes: Corrects or limits what the listener might assume from the first statement. Often followed by たった, ただ or 〜しか〜ない.

points.meaning: speaking of; when you think of; if you mention
points.formation: Noun + といえば / Noun + というと
points.ex_ja: 日本の夏の風物詩といえば、やはり花火大会だろう。
points.ex_en: When you think of summer traditions in Japan, fireworks festivals come to mind first.
points.notes: Introduces something closely associated with a topic, or picks up a word just mentioned to shift the conversation. 〜といったら is a more emotional variant.

points.meaning: have no choice but to; there's nothing to do but
points.formation: Verb-dict + ほかない / Verb-dict + よりほかない
points.ex_ja: 終電を逃してしまったので、タクシーで帰るほかない。
points.ex_en: I've missed the last train, so I have no choice but to take a taxi home.
points.notes: A somewhat formal equivalent of 〜しかない (N3). Variants: 〜ほかはない, 〜よりほかない, 〜ほかしかたがない.

points.meaning: will not (resolve); probably won't (conjecture)
points.formation: Verb-dict + まい / Verb-stem (ichidan verbs) + まい
points.ex_ja: あんな恥ずかしい思いは、二度とするまいと心に誓った。
points.ex_en: I swore to myself that I would never go through such embarrassment again.
points.notes: Written/formal. First person: firm resolve not to (〜ないつもりだ). Others: negative guess (〜ないだろう). する → するまい / すまい. Often 〜まいと思う / 〜まいと決心する.

points.meaning: let's (formal call to action); why don't we
points.formation: Verb-volitional + ではないか / Verb-volitional + ではありませんか
points.ex_ja: この町の未来のために、皆で力を合わせようではないか。
points.ex_en: For the future of this town, let us all join forces.
points.notes: A strong, formal appeal to a group, typical of speeches and editorials. The casual version is 〜(よ)うじゃないか.

points.meaning: without caring about; regardless of; paying no attention to
points.formation: Noun + もかまわず / Verb-plain + の + もかまわず
points.ex_ja: 彼女は人目もかまわず、駅のホームで大声で泣いた。
points.ex_en: She cried out loud on the station platform, not caring who was watching.
points.notes: Doing something without minding what people would normally care about (人目, 周囲, 雨). Often implies disapproval.

points.meaning: from the standpoint of; in terms of; for reasons of
points.formation: Noun + 上 / Noun + 上の + Noun
points.ex_ja: この映画には、教育上好ましくない場面が多い。
points.ex_en: This movie has many scenes that are undesirable from an educational standpoint.
points.notes: Attaches to Sino-Japanese nouns (歴史上, 経験上, 健康上, 表面上). Read じょう, not うえ.

points.meaning: there is a risk that; could (bad outcome)
points.formation: Verb-dict + おそれがある / Noun + の + おそれがある
points.ex_ja: 台風の影響で、今夜から大雨になるおそれがあります。
points.ex_en: Due to the typhoon, there is a risk of heavy rain from tonight.
points.notes: For undesirable possibilities; typical of news, weather reports and official warnings. Also written 〜恐れがある. 〜かねない sounds more like the speaker's own judgment.

points.meaning: perhaps because; maybe due to
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + せいか
points.ex_ja: 年のせいか、最近疲れが取れにくくなった。
points.ex_en: Maybe it's my age, but lately it takes longer to recover from fatigue.
points.notes: The speaker isn't sure of the cause. Mostly for bad or neutral results; for good results おかげか is also used.

points.meaning: as might be expected (since); precisely because; all the more because
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけあって・だけに
points.ex_ja: さすが一流ホテルだけあって、サービスが行き届いている。
points.ex_en: As you'd expect from a first-class hotel, the service is impeccable.
points.notes: だけあって praises a result that matches expectations (often with さすが). だけに also means 'all the more because' and can lead to negative outcomes.

points.meaning: it's no wonder; it lives up to; as expected of
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけのことはある
points.ex_ja: この料理は本当においしい。人気店だけのことはある。
points.ex_en: This food is really delicious. No wonder the place is so popular.
points.notes: Judges a result as fully justified by the effort, price or reputation; often with さすが. Like 〜だけあって, but placed at the end of the sentence.

points.meaning: even if; no matter
points.formation: たとえ + Verb-te + も / たとえ + i-Adj-ku + ても / たとえ + na-Adj + でも / たとえ + Noun + でも
points.ex_ja: たとえ反対されても、自分の夢を諦めるつもりはない。
points.ex_en: Even if people oppose me, I have no intention of giving up my dream.
points.notes: たとえ signals a hypothetical 'even if' in advance and strengthens it. A more written variant is たとえ〜としても.

points.meaning: what with ... and ...; and ... and (among other things)
points.formation: Noun + やら + Noun + やら / Verb-dict + やら + Verb-dict + やら / i-Adj + やら + i-Adj + やら
points.ex_ja: 引っ越しの前は、荷造りやら手続きやらで目が回るほど忙しかった。
points.ex_en: Before the move, what with packing and paperwork, I was run off my feet.
points.notes: Lists a few examples among many, often suggesting chaos or mixed feelings. Frequently followed by で + 大変だ / 忙しい.

points.meaning: get by without; not have to; be spared from
points.formation: Verb-nai stem + ずに済む / Verb-nai + で済む
points.ex_ja: 友人が車で送ってくれたので、タクシーを使わずに済んだ。
points.ex_en: My friend gave me a ride, so I didn't have to take a taxi.
points.notes: Something unpleasant or costly turned out to be unnecessary. する → せずに済む. Compare Noun + で済む, 'be settled with just ...'.

points.meaning: depending on how (one does it)
points.formation: Verb-stem + ようによっては
points.ex_ja: 考えようによっては、今回の失敗はいい教訓になったとも言える。
points.ex_en: Depending on how you look at it, you could say this failure taught us a good lesson.
points.notes: Mostly with 考え, 見, 言い, 使い: the result changes with the way A is done. Often offers a positive reinterpretation.

points.meaning: while; on the way; taking the opportunity of
points.formation: Verb-stem / Noun + がてら
points.ex_ja: 散歩がてら、駅前の本屋に寄って新刊をのぞいてきた。
points.ex_en: While out for a walk, I stopped by the bookstore in front of the station to look at the new releases.
points.notes: One outing serves two purposes; the main clause is usually a movement (行く, 寄る, 歩く). Compare 〜かたがた (formal, greetings and visits) and 〜かたわら (two long-term activities).

points.meaning: while also; alongside (one's main occupation)
points.formation: Verb-dict / Noun + の + かたわら
points.ex_ja: 彼女は会社勤めのかたわら、週末は日本語教室でボランティアをしている。
points.ex_en: Alongside her office job, she volunteers at a Japanese class on weekends.
points.notes: Two activities pursued in parallel over a long period (a job and a side pursuit), not a one-off action. As a plain noun, かたわら also means 'beside'.

points.meaning: the moment; no sooner ... than
points.formation: Verb-dict + が早いか
points.ex_ja: 子どもたちは玄関を開けるが早いか、ランドセルを放り出して遊びに行ってしまった。
points.ex_en: No sooner had the children opened the front door than they tossed their school bags aside and ran off to play.
points.notes: The second action follows almost instantly; it states a past fact, never a request or intention. Near-synonyms: 〜や否や (most formal), 〜なり (same subject, often surprising), 〜そばから (repeated).

points.meaning: even; not even (an extreme example)
points.formation: Noun (+ particle) + すら
points.ex_ja: 高熱が三日も続き、水を飲むことすらつらかった。
points.ex_en: The high fever lasted three days, and even drinking water was hard.
points.notes: A more literary 〜さえ. Unlike さえ, it is not used in the 〜さえ〜ば ('if only') construction.

points.meaning: nothing but; entirely; one ... after another
points.formation: Noun + ずくめ
points.ex_ja: 昇進に結婚、新居の購入と、今年はいいことずくめの一年だった。
points.ex_en: A promotion, a wedding and a new home — this year brought nothing but good things.
points.notes: Works with a limited set of nouns (黒, いいこと, 規則, ごちそう, 結構). Unlike だらけ or まみれ it can be positive and does not mean physically covered.

points.meaning: once ... (there's no going back); if ever ..., that's the end
points.formation: Verb-ta + ら最後 / Verb-ta + が最後
points.ex_ja: この子は一度泣き出したら最後、何をしても一時間は泣きやまない。
points.ex_en: Once this child starts crying, nothing will stop her for an hour.
points.notes: The result is bad or irreversible and stated with certainty. 〜が最後 is slightly more literary.

points.meaning: ever since
points.formation: Verb-te + からというもの
points.ex_ja: 犬を飼い始めてからというもの、父は毎朝六時に起きるようになった。
points.ex_en: Ever since we got a dog, my father has been getting up at six every morning.
points.notes: Stresses a marked, lasting change that began with the event; more emotional than the neutral 〜て以来.

points.meaning: never cease to; sincerely; deeply (hope, respect, love)
points.formation: Verb-te + やまない
points.ex_ja: 皆様のご健康とご多幸を心より願ってやみません。
points.ex_en: I sincerely wish you all good health and happiness.
points.notes: Used with verbs of feeling such as 願う, 祈る, 愛する, 尊敬する, 期待する. Typical of speeches, letters and formal writing.

points.meaning: combined with; coupled with
points.formation: Noun + と相まって / Noun + も相まって
points.ex_ja: 色づいた紅葉が澄んだ秋空と相まって、息をのむような景色をつくり出していた。
points.ex_en: The red autumn leaves, together with the clear autumn sky, created a breathtaking view.
points.notes: Two factors reinforce each other to produce a stronger effect. Also AとBが相まって and 〜も相まって.

points.meaning: when it comes to; once (a certain level or stage) is reached
points.formation: Noun / Verb-dict + ともなると / Noun / Verb-dict + ともなれば
points.ex_ja: 大企業の社長ともなると、分刻みのスケジュールで動かなければならない。
points.ex_en: When you're the president of a big company, you have to work to a minute-by-minute schedule.
points.notes: The noun marks a notably high status, time or amount; the rest states what naturally comes with it.

points.meaning: unique to; that only ... could offer
points.formation: Noun + ならではの + Noun / Noun + ならではだ
points.ex_ja: 港町ならではの新鮮な魚介料理を、心ゆくまで味わった。
points.ex_en: We savored to our hearts' content the fresh seafood you can only get in a port town.
points.notes: Almost always praise. The literary AならではBない means 'only A can B'.

points.meaning: in order to; with the aim of
points.formation: Verb-dict + べく (する → すべく)
points.ex_ja: 同社は海外市場に進出すべく、現地に新たな拠点を設けた。
points.ex_en: The company set up a new local base in order to expand into overseas markets.
points.notes: Formal written style; する usually becomes すべく. The main clause cannot be a request or command.

points.meaning: if one were to (do), (something terrible would happen)
points.formation: Verb-volitional + ものなら
points.ex_ja: 父の前で母の料理に文句でも言おうものなら、大変なことになる。
points.ex_en: If I were to complain about Mom's cooking in front of Dad, there'd be hell to pay.
points.notes: Exaggerates the danger of an action. Not to be confused with 〜ものなら (N2), which takes the potential form for an unlikely wish: 行けるものなら行きたい.

points.pattern: 〜に至る / 〜に至って / 〜に至っては
points.romaji: ni itaru / ni itatte / ni itatte wa
points.meaning: reach; lead to; only when it came to; as for (the most extreme case)
points.formation: Noun / Verb-dict + に至る / Noun / Verb-dict + に至って / Noun + に至っては
points.ex_ja: 小さな行き違いが、ついには両社の提携解消にまで至った。
points.ex_en: A small misunderstanding eventually led all the way to the two companies dissolving their partnership.
points.notes: に至る: reach a (serious) point. に至って: only once things came to that. に至っては: introduces the most extreme example, usually negative. Related: 〜に至るまで 'down to, even'.

points.meaning: cannot help feeling; cannot suppress (an emotion)
points.formation: Noun + を禁じ得ない
points.ex_ja: 罪のない子どもたちが犠牲になったことに、深い憤りを禁じ得ない。
points.ex_en: I cannot help feeling deep outrage that innocent children have become victims.
points.notes: Used with emotion nouns such as 怒り, 憤り, 同情, 驚き, 涙, 疑問. Formal; odd for trivial everyday feelings.

points.meaning: be forced to; have no choice but to
points.formation: Noun + を余儀なくされる
points.ex_ja: 大型台風の接近により、多くの便が欠航を余儀なくされた。
points.ex_en: With a major typhoon approaching, many flights had to be canceled.
points.notes: The noun is usually a suru-noun for an unwanted action (中止, 撤退, 変更, 入院). The active 〜を余儀なくさせる means 'force (someone) to'.

points.meaning: (only) possible because of; owe everything to
points.formation: Noun + あっての + Noun / Noun + あってのことだ
points.ex_ja: お客様あっての商売ですから、どんな小さな声にも耳を傾けなければならない。
points.ex_en: Our business exists only because of our customers, so we must listen to even the smallest voice.
points.notes: AあってのB: B exists only thanks to A, so A is indispensable. Often expresses gratitude.

points.meaning: depending on; regardless of
points.formation: Noun (+ の) + いかんで / Noun (+ の) + いかんによらず
points.ex_ja: 来季の契約は、今シーズンの成績いかんで決まる。
points.ex_en: Next season's contract will depend on this season's performance.
points.notes: Very formal (いかん = 'how, what'). Variants: 〜いかんによって / いかんでは (depending on); 〜いかんにかかわらず / いかんを問わず (regardless of).

points.meaning: no matter (what, how); even if
points.formation: Verb-volitional + が / Verb-volitional + と / i-Adj stem + かろうが / na-Adj + だろうが / Noun + だろうが
points.ex_ja: 周りに何と言われようが、自分で決めた道を進むつもりだ。
points.ex_en: No matter what people around me say, I intend to follow the path I chose.
points.notes: More emphatic than 〜ても; often with question words (何を, どこへ, いくら) or どんなに. The main clause shows the result is unaffected.

points.pattern: 〜(よ)うが〜まいが / 〜(よ)うと〜まいと
points.romaji: you ga ... mai ga / you to ... mai to
points.meaning: whether or not; regardless of whether
points.formation: Verb-volitional + が + Verb-dict + まいが / Verb-volitional + と + Verb-dict + まいと
points.ex_ja: 君が賛成しようがしまいが、この計画はもう動き出している。
points.ex_en: Whether you agree or not, this plan is already in motion.
points.notes: The same verb is repeated. For ichidan verbs and する/来る, まい may attach to the nai-stem: 認めまい, しまい (or すまい), こまい.

points.meaning: want to (do) but can't; even if one tries, one cannot
points.formation: Verb-volitional + にも + Verb-nai (potential of the same verb)
points.ex_ja: 財布を家に忘れてきたので、昼ご飯を買おうにも買えなかった。
points.ex_en: I'd left my wallet at home, so I couldn't buy lunch even though I wanted to.
points.notes: Some outside circumstance blocks the intended action. The second verb is usually the negative potential of the same verb, or 〜ようがない.

points.meaning: extremely; I feel so (emotion)
points.formation: i-Adj / na-Adj + な + かぎりだ
points.ex_ja: 長年の夢だった自分の店をついに開くことができ、うれしいかぎりだ。
points.ex_en: I've finally opened my own shop, a long-held dream, and I couldn't be happier.
points.notes: Expresses the speaker's own strong feeling with emotion adjectives (うれしい, 寂しい, 心細い, うらやましい, 残念な). Not used for other people's feelings.

points.meaning: while also; partly for the purpose of
points.formation: Noun + かたがた
points.ex_ja: 先日のお礼かたがた、ご挨拶に伺いたいと存じます。
points.ex_en: I would like to call on you to pay my respects, and also to thank you for the other day.
points.notes: Formal; typically with お礼, ご挨拶, ご報告, お見舞い plus a verb of visiting (伺う, 訪ねる). Compare casual 〜がてら and 〜かたわら (parallel long-term activities).

points.meaning: just when one thought ...; contrary to expectation
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かと思いきや
points.ex_ja: 今年の冬は暖かいかと思いきや、二月に入って記録的な大雪に見舞われた。
points.ex_en: We thought this winter would be mild, but then February brought record-breaking snow.
points.notes: The outcome contradicts what was expected. Also 〜と思いきや. Found in lively writing and essays more than in speech.

points.meaning: have a (bad) tendency to
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / Noun + の + きらいがある
points.ex_ja: 彼は何事も自分一人で抱え込むきらいがある。
points.ex_en: He has a tendency to shoulder everything by himself.
points.notes: Always critical; common in commentary about people's habits or institutions. Compare conversational 〜がち and neutral 〜傾向がある.

points.meaning: extremely; utterly
points.formation: na-Adj + 極まる / na-Adj + 極まりない
points.ex_ja: 公共の場で大声で電話をするなんて、迷惑極まりない。
points.ex_en: Talking loudly on the phone in a public place is extremely inconsiderate.
points.notes: Both mean the same; 極まりない is more common today. Mostly with negative na-adjectives (失礼, 危険, 不愉快, 退屈). 感極まる 'be overcome with emotion' is a set phrase.

points.meaning: the height of; the utmost
points.formation: Noun + の極み
points.ex_ja: 決勝戦であのような凡ミスをしたことは、まさに痛恨の極みだ。
points.ex_en: Making such a careless error in the final is the most bitter regret imaginable.
points.notes: Common with 光栄, 感激, 痛恨, ぜいたく, 疲労. Compare 〜の至り, which is limited to a few set phrases about the speaker's own feelings.

points.meaning: like; as; (after a person) the likes of
points.formation: Noun + の + ごとく / Verb-plain + (が) + ごとく / Noun + (の) + ごとき + Noun
points.ex_ja: 彼女は何事もなかったかのごとく、静かに微笑んでいた。
points.ex_en: She was smiling quietly as if nothing had happened.
points.notes: Literary equivalent of 〜ように / 〜ような. ごとき directly after a person shows contempt (お前ごとき) or, for oneself, humility (私ごとき).

points.meaning: because; since (as an excuse or apology)
points.formation: Verb-plain / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + こととて
points.ex_ja: 何分にも不慣れなこととて、至らぬ点があればご容赦ください。
points.ex_en: As I am still new to this, please forgive any shortcomings.
points.notes: Old-fashioned and formal, mainly in apologies or requests for understanding. Often with ぬ (知らぬこととて 'since I didn't know').

points.meaning: without (doing)
points.formation: Verb-dict + ことなしに
points.ex_ja: 基礎を固めることなしに、応用力は身につかない。
points.ex_en: Without building a solid foundation, you will never develop the ability to apply what you know.
points.notes: Often followed by an impossibility ('without A, B cannot happen'). Close to 〜ことなく (N2), which simply means 'without doing'.

points.meaning: end up (in a bad state); (things) have come to this
points.formation: Verb-dict + 始末だ / この + 始末だ
points.ex_ja: 弟は遊んでばかりいて、とうとう単位が足りずに留年する始末だ。
points.ex_en: My brother did nothing but play, and he ended up having to repeat a year for lack of credits.
points.notes: A bad outcome after a series of events, told with exasperation. Often with とうとう, ついには, 挙げ句の果てに.

points.meaning: end up never doing; never got around to
points.formation: Verb-nai stem + ずじまい (する → せずじまい)
points.ex_ja: 旅行中は雨続きで、楽しみにしていた山には登らずじまいだった。
points.ex_en: It rained throughout the trip, so I never got to climb the mountain I'd been looking forward to.
points.notes: Regret that an intended action never happened before the chance passed. Usually 〜ずじまいだった / 〜ずじまいになった.

points.pattern: 〜ずにはおかない / 〜ないではおかない
points.romaji: zu ni wa okanai / nai de wa okanai
points.meaning: will definitely (do); cannot fail to (cause a reaction)
points.formation: Verb-nai stem + ずにはおかない (する → せずにはおかない) / Verb-nai + ではおかない
points.ex_ja: 彼女の力強い歌声は、聴く者の心を揺さぶらずにはおかない。
points.ex_en: Her powerful voice cannot fail to move the hearts of those who hear it.
points.notes: Two uses: firm resolve, or something that inevitably causes a feeling or reaction. Compare 〜ずにはいられない (N2), one's own irresistible urge.

points.pattern: 〜ずにはすまない / 〜ないではすまない
points.romaji: zu ni wa sumanai / nai de wa sumanai
points.meaning: must (do); won't get away without (doing)
points.formation: Verb-nai stem + ずにはすまない (する → せずにはすまない) / Verb-nai + ではすまない
points.ex_ja: 大切な花瓶を割ってしまったのだから、弁償せずにはすまないだろう。
points.ex_en: Since I broke that precious vase, I won't get away without paying for it.
points.notes: The obligation comes from social norms or the situation, not personal desire. 〜ずには済まされない is a stronger variant.

points.meaning: as soon as (and again and again)
points.formation: Verb-dict / Verb-ta + そばから
points.ex_ja: 片付けるそばから、子どもたちがおもちゃを散らかしていく。
points.ex_en: As soon as I tidy up, the kids scatter their toys around again.
points.notes: A repeated pattern where the second action undoes the first, often with frustration. Unlike 〜や否や or 〜なり, it is not used for a single one-off event.

points.meaning: not even (one); not a single
points.formation: Noun (一 + counter) + たりとも
points.ex_ja: 税金を一円たりとも無駄にしてはならない。
points.ex_en: Not a single yen of tax money must be wasted.
points.notes: Attaches to 一 + counter (一円, 一日, 一人, 一瞬) and is followed by a negative or prohibition. Also 何人たりとも 'no one whatsoever'.

points.meaning: even (just); not even
points.formation: Verb-dict + だに / Noun + だに
points.ex_ja: あの事故の瞬間は、思い出すだに身震いがする。
points.ex_en: Just recalling the moment of that accident makes me shudder.
points.notes: Archaic; survives mainly in set phrases: 想像するだに / 考えるだに ('just thinking about it'), 微動だにしない, 想像だにしない / 夢想だにしない ('never even imagine').

points.meaning: as (one in the position of); befitting
points.formation: Noun + たる + Noun / Noun + たるもの
points.ex_ja: 教師たる者、生徒の前で模範を示さなければならない。
points.ex_en: Anyone who is a teacher must set an example in front of the students.
points.notes: Stresses the duties or dignity expected of a role. 〜たる者 / 〜たるもの is followed by what such a person should (not) do.

points.meaning: (doing) A and B alternately; back and forth
points.formation: Verb-stem + つ + Verb-stem + つ
points.ex_ja: 近所の人たちとは、持ちつ持たれつの関係でやってきた。
points.ex_en: My neighbors and I have always helped each other out.
points.notes: Only in set phrases with opposite verbs or active/passive pairs: 行きつ戻りつ, 持ちつ持たれつ, 抜きつ抜かれつ, 浮きつ沈みつ.

points.romaji: de are / de are ... de are
points.meaning: whatever (it is); whoever; whether A or B
points.formation: Noun + であれ / Question word + であれ / Noun + であれ + Noun + であれ
points.ex_ja: 理由が何であれ、暴力は決して許されない。
points.ex_en: Whatever the reason, violence is never acceptable.
points.notes: Written equivalent of 〜でも / 〜だろうと. 〜であろうと and 〜であろうが are close variants.

points.meaning: ought to; it would only be natural to
points.formation: Verb-te + しかるべきだ / i-Adj-ku + て + しかるべきだ / na-Adj + であって + しかるべきだ
points.ex_ja: これだけの損害を出したのだから、経営陣は責任を問われてしかるべきだ。
points.ex_en: Having caused this much damage, the management ought to be held accountable.
points.notes: States what would be proper, often in the passive and often implying criticism that it hasn't happened. The adjective しかるべき also means 'appropriate'.

points.meaning: it's not as if (one were); since (one) is not
points.formation: Noun + ではあるまいし / Verb-dict + の + ではあるまいし
points.ex_ja: 子どもではあるまいし、自分のことくらい自分で決めなさい。
points.ex_en: You're not a child, so make your own decisions about yourself.
points.notes: Followed by a judgment, advice or command. Despite the formal まい, it's common in speech, especially as 〜じゃあるまいし.

points.meaning: since (considering how it looks to others); out of consideration for
points.formation: Verb-plain / Noun + の + 手前
points.ex_ja: 部下の手前、上司の私が弱音を吐くことはできなかった。
points.ex_en: In front of my subordinates, I couldn't let myself complain as their boss.
points.notes: Because of what one has said or one's position in front of others, one feels bound to act a certain way. Often followed by 〜わけにはいかない or 〜しかない.

points.meaning: it's all right to; there's no problem if
points.formation: Verb-te + もさしつかえない / i-Adj-ku + て + もさしつかえない / na-Adj + でもさしつかえない / Noun + でもさしつかえない
points.ex_ja: 書類は鉛筆で記入してもさしつかえありません。
points.ex_en: You may fill in the form in pencil.
points.notes: A more formal 〜てもいい / 〜ても構わない, common in business, notices and official instructions. Often written 差し支えない.

points.meaning: because (of a special situation); as it is
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とあって
points.ex_ja: 三連休の初日とあって、高速道路はどこも大渋滞だった。
points.ex_en: It being the first day of a three-day weekend, the expressways were jammed everywhere.
points.notes: The cause is a special, noteworthy situation, and the main clause reports its natural, observed result. Common in news; not used for the speaker's own wishes or requests.

points.meaning: if it's (for); if (such a special case) is so
points.formation: Verb-plain / Noun + とあれば
points.ex_ja: 子どもの命を救うためとあれば、どんな犠牲も惜しまない。
points.ex_en: If it's to save my child's life, I'll spare no sacrifice.
points.notes: A special condition under which one would make an exception or do something difficult. Frequently 〜のためとあれば.

points.meaning: both A and B; in terms of A as well as B
points.formation: Noun + といい + Noun + といい
points.ex_ja: この旅館は、料理といい接客といい、申し分ない。
points.ex_en: This inn is flawless, both in its food and its service.
points.notes: Picks out two aspects as evidence for an overall evaluation, positive or negative. Unlike plain 〜も〜も, it carries the speaker's judgment.

points.meaning: at most; about; more or less
points.formation: Noun / Verb-dict + といったところだ
points.ex_ja: 私の料理の腕前は、せいぜいカレーが作れるといったところだ。
points.ex_en: My cooking skills amount to making curry, at best.
points.notes: A rough, modest estimate: the amount or level isn't large. Often with せいぜい or まあ. Also 〜というところだ.

points.meaning: even though; even (someone like)
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + といえども
points.ex_ja: 子どもといえども、一人の人間として尊重されなければならない。
points.ex_en: Children too must be respected as individuals.
points.notes: Formal version of 〜といっても / 〜であっても: even someone with that status is not exempt. Often with いかなる or たとえ.

points.meaning: indescribably; extremely; beyond words
points.formation: i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + といったらない
points.ex_ja: 決勝戦で一点差で負けたときの悔しさといったらなかった。
points.ex_en: The frustration of losing the final by a single point was beyond words.
points.notes: Works for both positive and negative feelings. Casual forms: 〜ったらない, and 〜といったらありゃしない (negative only).

points.meaning: when it comes to; as for (complaint)
points.formation: Noun + ときたら
points.ex_ja: うちの夫ときたら、休みの日は一日中ソファでごろごろしている。
points.ex_en: As for my husband, he lazes around on the sofa all day on his days off.
points.notes: Introduces a familiar person or thing the speaker is fed up with; what follows is a complaint. Conversational.

points.pattern: 〜としたところで / 〜にしたところで
points.romaji: to shita tokoro de / ni shita tokoro de
points.meaning: even if; even supposing; even for (someone)
points.formation: Verb-plain / Noun + としたところで / Noun + にしたところで
points.ex_ja: 今から急いだとしたところで、最終電車には間に合わないだろう。
points.ex_en: Even if we hurried now, we probably wouldn't make the last train.
points.notes: Like 〜としても / 〜にしても, but stresses that the outcome won't change. Casual: 〜としたって / 〜にしたって.

points.meaning: (to think) that ...!; I'm surprised that
points.formation: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とは
points.ex_ja: あの真面目な彼が、会社の金に手をつけていたとは。
points.ex_en: To think that someone as serious as him had been dipping into company money!
points.notes: Can end the sentence, leaving the reaction unsaid, or be followed by 思わなかった, 驚いた, etc. Different from definitional 〜とは ('X means ...').

points.meaning: as if to say
points.formation: Sentence + とばかりに
points.ex_ja: 店員は「早く帰れ」とばかりに、私たちのテーブルを片付け始めた。
points.ex_en: The waiter began clearing our table as if to say, 'Hurry up and leave.'
points.notes: Describes someone else's attitude or gesture that seems to say something without words; not used about oneself. Compare 〜んばかり (a nearly-reached extreme state).

points.romaji: to mo naku / to mo nashi ni
points.meaning: without meaning to; idly; (with question words) no particular
points.formation: Verb-dict + ともなく / Verb-dict + ともなしに / Question word + (particle) + ともなく
points.ex_ja: 電車の中で、隣の二人の会話を聞くともなく聞いていた。
points.ex_en: On the train, I was half-listening to the conversation of the two people next to me.
points.notes: The same verb is usually repeated (見るともなく見る). With question words: どこからともなく 'from nowhere in particular', 誰からともなく 'someone or other'.

points.meaning: even if not (to that extent), at least
points.formation: Verb-nai + までも
points.ex_ja: 毎日とは言わないまでも、週に一度くらいは実家に電話しなさい。
points.ex_en: I won't say every day, but at least call home once a week.
points.notes: The first part names a high level not reached; the second a lower, acceptable level, often with せめて, 少なくとも or advice.

points.meaning: it's not impossible that; might (under some conditions)
points.formation: Verb-nai + ものでもない
points.ex_ja: 条件次第では、その仕事を引き受けないものでもない。
points.ex_en: Depending on the terms, I might be willing to take on the job.
points.notes: A roundabout, somewhat reluctant way to admit a possibility. Similar to 〜ないことはない (N3) but stiffer.

points.meaning: as (it was); while remaining; since (birth)
points.formation: Noun + ながらに / Noun + ながらの + Noun / Verb-stem + ながらに
points.ex_ja: この町には、昔ながらの手作りの和菓子屋が今も残っている。
points.ex_en: This town still has an old-fashioned shop that makes Japanese sweets by hand.
points.notes: Limited to set expressions: 昔ながら, 涙ながら, 生まれながら, いつもながら, いながらにして ('without leaving one's place').

points.meaning: without (something essential), (cannot)
points.formation: Noun + なくして(は)
points.ex_ja: 地域住民の理解なくして、この計画の成功はあり得ない。
points.ex_en: Without the understanding of local residents, this project cannot succeed.
points.notes: Followed by a negative or impossibility; stresses that the noun is indispensable. More emphatic and literary than 〜なしに(は).

points.meaning: without
points.formation: Noun + なしに(は)
points.ex_ja: 彼は何の連絡もなしに、三日間会社を休んだ。
points.ex_en: He stayed away from work for three days without any notice.
points.notes: なしに simply means 'without'; なしには is followed by a negative ('can't ... without'). Conversation often uses 〜なしで.

points.pattern: 〜ならいざしらず / 〜はいざしらず
points.romaji: nara iza shirazu / wa iza shirazu
points.meaning: it may be different for ..., but; I don't know about ..., but
points.formation: Noun + ならいざしらず / Noun + はいざしらず / Verb-plain + (の) + ならいざしらず
points.ex_ja: 子どもならいざしらず、大人がこんな簡単な漢字も読めないとは情けない。
points.ex_en: It would be one thing for a child, but it's shameful that an adult can't read such simple kanji.
points.notes: The first case could be excused or is unknown; the actual case is judged more strictly. Close to 〜ならまだしも, but more literary.

points.meaning: if it were ..., it would be one thing (but)
points.formation: Noun + ならまだしも / Verb-plain + (の) + ならまだしも
points.ex_ja: 一度ならまだしも、同じミスを三度も繰り返すのは問題だ。
